evals.prompt: Redesign an Apps Script inventory dashboard used mostly on phones. It has a 14-column table, slow loading, no empty state, and tiny action buttons.
evals.expected_output: A task-led mobile information architecture, responsive data strategy, full async state model, accessible controls, performance plan, implementation changes, and verification matrix.

evals.prompt: Make our Apps Script approval dialog keyboard accessible. Focus is lost after google.script.run returns and validation is only shown with red borders.
evals.expected_output: Semantic dialog behavior, focus management/restoration, labeled errors, status announcements, non-color cues, asynchronous state handling, and keyboard tests.
